items.mainDefect: An explicit process count of zero is treated as None and unexpectedly selects one flusher process per shard.

secondary.defect: Negative process counts create zero flusher processes, leaving ingestion running without flushing or backpressure.

items.mainDefect: The wait_produce metric uses the tag key "shards" while sibling metrics use "shard", fragmenting the same dimension.

secondary.defect: The flusher_unhealthy metric uses individual shard IDs while main-loop metrics use comma-joined shard IDs under the same tag key.

items.mainDefect: The newly added _create_process_for_shard method has no callers and is dead code.

secondary.defect: If called, _create_process_for_shard would overwrite the existing process reference without killing the old process, leaking it and its shared state.

items.mainDefect: The restart path's isinstance check excludes SpawnProcess instances, preventing hung processes from being killed before replacements start.

secondary.defect: The same incorrect isinstance check in join() prevents SpawnProcess instances from being terminated during shutdown.

items.mainDefect: The internal child-factory construction fails to forward flusher_processes, causing the multiprocessing path to ignore the configured limit.

secondary.defect: A positional produce_to_pipe argument at the unchanged child-factory call would bind to the newly inserted flusher_processes parameter and cause a TypeError.
